name: shuvscode-gh
description: GitHub onboarding and gh CLI integration for shuvscode.

shuvscode.gh.colocateWithSourceControl.description: On first activation, move the GitHub Pull Requests, Issues, and Notifications views into the Source Control container so they appear in the same sidebar pane as Repos / Changes / Graph. Has no effect after the move has been performed once per profile; drag the views elsewhere afterwards and shuvscode will not fight the change.

shuvscode.gh.dash.enabled.description: Detect gh-dash for terminal-first GitHub dashboard workflows.

shuvscode.gh.dash.executablePath.description: Optional explicit gh-dash executable path. When empty, shuvscode tries `gh dash` first, then `gh-dash`.

shuvscode.gh.dash.terminalName.description: Terminal name to use for future gh-dash launch commands.

shuvscode.gh.dash.autoPromptInstall.description: Prompt before offering gh-dash installation guidance when gh is available but gh-dash is missing.
